_comment: B1 group manifest for TASK-002 section 2.3.1. The 41 B1 tools (42 old tools of DESIGN-DETAIL.md section 10 minus get_editor_performance, which GDR-17 merged losslessly into editor_get_performance_monitors) are partitioned into 7 groups. Each group is one channel + one mutating value, so its tools fit one tools/<group>.{h,cpp} file and no two groups share a file. Every tool name is the frozen v1.1 contract name from docs/tools_list.renamed.json; every group is exactly one batch of parallel porting work.

source.excluded: get_editor_performance (disposition=merge_into, GDR-17; the survivor editor_get_performance_monitors belongs to the profiling group of a later batch)

alerts.note: editor_remove_output_log (old clear_output) is flagged fix_implementation_first in tool-rename-map.json: its implementation must be fixed first, driven by a red test, before it is registered. It sits in editor_write_scene_editor, which is not the template group, so TASK-002 does not implement it.

groups.name: project_read_template
groups.notes: The TASK-002 template group: 2 migrated tools plus 4 new ones. Owns tools/project_read_template.{h,cpp}.

groups.name: project_read_analysis
groups.notes: Read-only project analysis (migration source: commands/analysis.rs). No file is shared with the template group.

groups.name: project_read_files
groups.notes: Read-only project content (scripts / resources / scene text). Pure disk reads, no editor dependency.

groups.name: project_write_resource_scene
groups.notes: The only mutating project group of B1: writes res:// and therefore needs the write-path evidence class (success / missing param / bottom layer failure).

groups.name: editor_read_scene_inspector
groups.notes: Editor-process reads; the group file guards editor-only APIs and registers every tool as scope=EDITOR. It is the first editor-scope group of the port, so the 'a game process must not expose editor tools' rule is pinned end to end: check_contract_subset.ps1 asserts the editor endpoint serves these seven and the game endpoint serves none of them.

groups.name: editor_write_scene_editor
groups.notes: Editor-process writes. Contains editor_remove_output_log from the map's fix_implementation_first set: write the red test first, fix the implementation, then register.

groups.name: running_game_read_scene
groups.notes: The single game-process tool of B1; scope=GAME, so it must not appear in the editor tools/list. Kept as its own one-tool group because a group has exactly one channel.
